tasks.title: Take the apple
tasks.description: Control Kepler so that he finds the apple!

requirements.title: The apple moves on its own
requirements.text: How does the Apple sprite move? Use the example from the demo project or come up with your own method!

requirements.title: Controlling Kepler
requirements.text: Program Kepler control. Use the right and left arrow keys to change Kepler’s x position. Switch costumes while he moves.

requirements.title: Kepler and the apple touching
requirements.text: If Kepler touches the apple, broadcast a message. When the Apple sprite receives it, it hides. Kepler says “Yummy!”

requirements.title: Initial placement
requirements.text: When the green flag is clicked, put the apple and Kepler back in their starting positions and show the apple again.
